install.windows_download: Open https://www.trae.cn/download in the browser, click the Windows installer. Saves to %USERPROFILE%\Downloads by default.
install.macos_download: Open https://www.trae.cn/download in the browser, click the macOS download (.dmg). Saves to ~/Downloads by default.
install.linux_download: Open https://www.trae.cn/download and select the TRAE IDE Linux .deb / .rpm matching the architecture and distribution. Install the downloaded package with apt / dnf / zypper. The download center also lists other TRAE products; select the IDE for this tool card.
install.note: GUI IDE by ByteDance — China-region build of Trae. Echobird does NOT switch its model; model selection lives inside the app.

install_flow.summary: Select the IDE installer for the target OS and architecture → install → verify the application entry.
agent_steps: Detect OS and architecture first. The official download center supports Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Open https://www.trae.cn/download and select the TRAE IDE for this tool card. Keep the international / China build distinct from other products in the download center.

Save the matching installer to Downloads and report the exact path. Windows/macOS: open it and let the user complete the installer. Linux: install the downloaded .deb / .rpm with the distro package manager.
Verify the selected IDE is present in the application menu and opens.
tell_user: That Trae CN handles its own model selection — Echobird does NOT switch models for it

identity_guard.description: Trae CN is the China-region (trae.cn) build by ByteDance, optimized for mainland China network access. It is DIFFERENT from Trae (trae.ai), the international build. Prefer Trae CN for users in mainland China.
